templates.pattern: [N] people [P1], [P2], [P3], [P4], [P5] sit in a row. [P1] sits at the leftmost end. [P5] sits at the rightmost end. [P3] sits exactly in the middle. Who sits to the immediate right of [P3]?
templates.explanation: Order: [P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]. [P3] is in middle (pos 3), so immediate right is pos 4 = [P4]

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a straight row facing north. [P1] is at position [POS1] from left. [P2] is at position [POS2] from left. How many persons sit between [P1] and [P2]?
templates.explanation: Persons between = |POS2 - POS1| - 1 = |[POS2]-[POS1]| - 1

templates.pattern: [N] people sit in a row. [P1] is [K] places to the left of [P2]. [P2] is at position [POS] from the right end. What is [P1]'s position from the left end?
templates.explanation: [P2] position from left = N-POS+1 = [N]-[POS]+1. [P1] is [K] left of [P2], so [P1] pos from left = [N]-[POS]+1-[K]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from left and [P2] is [B]th from right. If they interchange positions, [P1] becomes [C]th from left. How many students are between them originally?
templates.explanation: [P2] from left = N-B+1. Between them = |[P2]_left - [P1]_left| - 1

templates.pattern: [N] friends [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5] sit around a circular table. [P1] sits opposite [P3]. [P2] sits to the immediate right of [P1]. Who sits to the immediate left of [P3]?
templates.explanation: In circular arrangement, if [P2] is immediate right of [P1], and [P1] is opposite [P3], then [P2] is immediate left of [P3]

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a row. [P1] is at position [A] from left. What is [P1]'s position from the right end?
templates.explanation: Position from right = N - Position from left + 1 = [N]-[A]+1

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] children, [P1] is [A]th from the left and [P2] is [B]th from the left. [P3] sits exactly between [P1] and [P2]. What is [P3]'s position from the left?
templates.explanation: Middle position = (A+B)/2 = ([A]+[B])/2

templates.pattern: [N] people [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5],[P6] sit in two rows of 3 each, facing each other. [P1],[P2],[P3] face south. [P4],[P5],[P6] face north. [P1] faces [P4]. [P2] is to the right of [P1]. Who faces [P2]?
templates.explanation: Row 1(south): [P1]-[P2]-[P3]. Row 2(north): [P4]-[P5]-[P6]. [P1] faces [P4], so [P2] faces [P5]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, if [P1] is shifted [K] places to the right, he occupies the middle position. What is [P1]'s original position from the left?
templates.explanation: Middle position = (N+1)/2. Original position = middle - K = [N+1]/2 - [K]

templates.pattern: [N] people sit in a circle. [P1] is [A] places to the right of [P2]. How many people are between them going from [P2] to [P1] in the longer (left) direction?
templates.explanation: Longer direction count = N - shorter direction - 2 = [N]-[A]-1

templates.pattern: Five people [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5] sit in a row. [P1] is not at ends. [P3] is at the rightmost end. [P2] is to the immediate left of [P3]. [P4] is at leftmost end. Who is at the second position from left?
templates.explanation: Order: [P4]-?-[P1]-[P2]-[P3]. Position 2 must be [P5]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from left and [P2] is [B]th from right. Total number of students between them?
templates.explanation: Students between = N - A - B = [N]-[A]-[B]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] people, [P1] is [A]th from left. If [K] more people join the row to the left of [P1], what is [P1]'s new position from left?
templates.explanation: New position from left = original position + people added to left = [A]+[K]

templates.pattern: [N] athletes sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left and [B]th from right. How many athletes are in the row?
templates.explanation: Total = Position from left + Position from right - 1 = [A]+[B]-1

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] ranks [A]th from top and [P2] ranks [B]th from bottom. If [C] students are between them, what is the total number of students?
templates.explanation: Total = Rank from top + Rank from bottom + Between them - ... use: A+B-1-C gives overlap. Here total = A+B+C (when they don't overlap)

templates.pattern: Four people [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4] sit around a square table, one on each side. [P1] faces north. [P2] faces [P1]. [P3] is to the right of [P1]. Who faces [P3]?
templates.explanation: [P1] faces north (south side), [P2] faces [P1] (north side). [P3] is right of [P1] (east side). Facing [P3] from west side = [P4]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is exactly in the middle. [P1] is [A]th from the right. How many persons are to the left of [P1]?
templates.explanation: Since [P1] is in the middle, position from right = position from left. Left of [P1] = A-1 = [A]-1

templates.pattern: [N] players sit in a row. [P1] is [A] places to the right of [P2]. [P2] is at position [B] from left. What is [P1]'s position from right?
templates.explanation: [P1] position from left = A+B = [A]+[B]. From right = N-(A+B)+1 = [N]-([A]+[B])+1

templates.pattern: In a linear row of [N] people facing north, [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B] places to the right of [P1]. What is [P2]'s position from the right?
templates.explanation: [P2] from left = A+B. [P2] from right = N-(A+B)+1 = [N]-([A]+[B])+1

templates.pattern: Eight people sit in two rows of 4. Row 1: [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4] face south. Row 2: [P5],[P6],[P7],[P8] face north. [P2] faces [P7]. [P1] is to the immediate left of [P2]. Who faces [P1]?
templates.explanation: Row 1: [P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]. Row 2: [P8]-[P7]-[P6]-[P5] (mirror). [P2] faces [P7]. [P1] is left of [P2], so [P1] faces [P8]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left. How many minimum persons need to be added to make [P1]'s position [B]th from right?
templates.explanation: Required total = A+B-1. Extra needed = max(0, (A+B-1)-N) = max(0,([A]+[B]-1)-[N])

templates.pattern: Five friends [P1],[P2],[P3],[P4],[P5] sit in a row. [P3] is to the right of [P1] but left of [P5]. [P2] is at the leftmost end. [P4] is between [P3] and [P5]. Who sits at the rightmost end?
templates.explanation: Order: [P2]-[P1]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]. Rightmost = [P5]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from right and [P2] is [B]th from left. If [P1] and [P2] are the same person, how many students are in the row?
templates.explanation: Total students = Position from right + Position from left - 1 = [A]+[B]-1

templates.pattern: [N] people sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from left. They swap positions. Now [P1] is [C]th from right. What is the total number of people in the row?
templates.explanation: After swap, [P1] is at [P2]'s original position ([B] from left) and [C]th from right. Total = B+C-1 = [B]+[C]-1
